/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-app-templa.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-app-templa.name: external-dns
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-app-templa.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

mode: cluster
ingress: true
gateway: true

---
# For configuration options and examples, please see:
# https://gethomepage.dev/latest/configs/settings

instanceName: external

providers:
  openweathermap: openweathermapapikey
  weatherapi: weatherapiapikey

useEqualHeights: true

layout:
  - Home Automation:
      icon: mdi-home
      style: row
      columns: 3
  - Tools:
      icon: mdi-tools
  - Finance:
      icon: mdi-cash-multiple
      #style: row
      #columns: 3
  - Default:
      style: row
      columns: 3

---
# For configuration options and examples, please see:
# https://gethomepage.dev/latest/configs/widgets

- resources:
    cpu: true
    memory: true
    #disk: /

- search:
    provider: duckduckgo
    target: _blank

---
# For configuration options and examples, please see:
# https://gethomepage.dev/latest/configs/services
#
#
- Community:
  - Cinny:
      href: https://app.cinny.in/login/${DOMAIN_0}
      description: Matrix client for voice and text chat
      icon: https://cinny.in/assets/favicon-16x16.png
      widget:
        type: prometheusmetric
        url: http://prometheus-operated.kube-prometheus-stack.svc.cluster.local:9090
        refreshInterval: 10000 # optional - in milliseconds, defaults to 10s
        metrics:
          - label: Live Chatters
            query: livekit_participant_total
